I will keep my land in the usual wheat-maize rotation. In Quzhou County, this is the most reliable way for me to use the full year, protect my grain supply, and avoid taking on too much risk at my age. I will stay with crops I know how to manage and that fit our local water, weather, and market conditions. I will keep inputs moderate rather than chase the highest possible yield, because I care more about a stable harvest and manageable fieldwork. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for me and common here. I will plant improved wheat seed for steady performance, then hybrid summer maize after wheat harvest because maize responds well and gives me stronger yield. I will irrigate only at the key times and keep pesticide sprays limited to when pressure is real, since water and cash both matter to me.
